theme: Morph: megamorph payoffs, returns face down, spell theft
reuse: Megamorph(); 'As this creature is turned face up, put five +1/+1 counters' is a replacement on the turn-up, not a trigger: crowd_control_warden.go, bubble_smuggler.go; return to the battlefield face down (Ashcloud Phoenix, Deathmist Raptor 'face up or face down'): game/face_down.go, battlefield_put.go; 'whenever a permanent you control is turned face up' shared here; exile a spell and cast it later free (Smirking Spelljacker, Kheru Spellsnatcher's counter-then-exile) is one helper for both: aven_interrupter.go, game/exile_spell_keyed.go, exile_play.go.
